about: Dating Stories 2 blends the addictive satisfaction of solving jigsaw puzzles with the spicy thrill of seducing the most alluring women you can imagine. Piece together each stunning image to unlock steamy conversations — and discover just how far every encounter can go. One perfect line pulls you closer to a tempting finish… one wrong word ends the moment cold. The outcome is always in your hands.
- Solve puzzles featuring absolutely stunning women, each with her own irresistible style and personality.
- Choose your words wisely — say the right thing and feel the tension rise.
- Read the mood, make your move, and unlock every encounter's most satisfying ending.
- A whole roster of tempting new stories is waiting — how many can you win over?
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
